notes.title: Assessment is the last step
notes.body: Your Amazon Launch application is in, six days early. One required step is left: the online assessment, which expires 2 December. Amazon will not review the application until it is done. - Give it one uninterrupted sitting rather than squeezing it between other things.
acted: Apply: Amazon Launch MBA intern, Luxembourg: To-do -> Done
Amazon Launch online assessment: added, due 03 Nov
